scripts.title: Axon Hub | Auto Farm, Auto Loot, Auto Spin & ESP
scripts.features:
Axon Hub for Dungeon Lootr brings together Auto Farm, Auto Loot, Auto Spin, Auto Sell, equipment upgrades, and customizable ESP. Automate repetitive combat, manage your inventory, and choose the classes and aspects you want to roll for.

AUTO FARM & COMBAT

- Auto Kill NPC — automatically targets enemies and attacks while staying above them.
- Adjustable Farm Height — choose your distance above the enemy.
- Auto Abilities — select which available class abilities to use during farming.
- Auto Heal — use your equipped healing potion when missing health reaches your chosen threshold.

LOOT & CHESTS

- Auto Pickup Loot — collect dropped coins and other supported drops.
- Auto Reward Selection — select and claim available dungeon reward chests.
- Auto Open Chests — open stored chests and confirm their rewards.
- Chest Pickup — teleport to and collect an available world chest.
- Take Blessing — teleport to an available blessing and interact with it.
- Chest and blessing teleports are single-use actions with Auto Kill turned off.

AUTO SPIN & ASPECT ROLLS

- Auto Spin — use your available Normal Spins automatically.
- Auto Lucky Spin — roll using your available Lucky Spins.
- Class Targeting — stop when your selected class or rarity appears.
- Auto Roll Aspect Gems — reroll using your available Aspect Gems.
- Aspect Targeting — select specific aspects or target rarities.
- Accept Higher Rarity — optionally stop on results above your selected rarity.

INVENTORY & UPGRADES

- Auto Equip Best — compare usable equipment and equip higher-scoring items.
- Auto Sell — sell selected rarities from loot storage and unequipped inventory.
- Auto Upgrade Stats — allocate available points into STR, DEX, INT, or VIT.
- Share All — distribute stat points evenly.
- Forge Equipment — upgrade equipped headgear, body armor, and rings using your materials.
- Optional Protection Scroll and Purity Stone support when owned.

REWARDS & POTIONS

- Auto Claim Quests — collect completed quest rewards.
- Auto Claim Battlepass — collect eligible battlepass rewards.
- Auto Use Potions — consume available luck buffs and instant-use items, including Class XP Essence.
- Code Redemption — redeem the included code list or enter a code manually.

ESP & MOVEMENT

- NPC ESP, Chest ESP, and Cauldron ESP.
- Customize display information, colors, range, text size, and font.
- Fly with adjustable speed.
- Adjustable walk speed, Noclip, and Infinite Jump.
- Teleport to the nearest matching combat NPC.
- Save and load your preferred settings.

CloseCrossBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

local CrossCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

-- Title
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "CASH AUTO MENU"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.TextSize = 16
Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Title.Parent = Frame

-- Layout
local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
UIListLayout.Parent = Frame
UIListLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
UIListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)

-- Helper to Create Buttons
local function createToggleButton(name, text, layoutOrder)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Name = name
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 40)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    button.Text = text .. " [OFF]"
    button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansSemibold
    button.TextSize = 14
    button.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
    button.Parent = Frame

    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    btnCorner.Parent = button

    return button
end

local ConvertBtn = createToggleButton("ConvertCash", "Auto Convert Cash", 1)
local ClaimBtn = createToggleButton("ClaimCash", "Auto Claim Cash", 2)
local UpgradeBtn = createToggleButton("UpgradeCash", "Auto Upgrade Cash", 3)

-- Close Button (Red X) Click Logic
CloseCrossBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Frame.Visible = false
end)

-- Reopen UI Button Click Logic
OpenCloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Frame.Visible = not Frame.Visible
end)

-- Handle Toggle Visuals and Auto Loops
local function setupToggle(button, toggleKey, baseText, actionCallback)
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Toggles[toggleKey] = not Toggles[toggleKey]

        if Toggles[toggleKey] then
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 139, 87)
            button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            button.Text = baseText .. " [ON]"

            task.spawn(function()
                while Toggles[toggleKey] do
                    actionCallback()
                    task.wait(1)
                end
            end)
        else
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
            button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
            button.Text = baseText .. " [OFF]"
        end
    end)
end

-- 1. Auto Convert Cash Logic
setupToggle(ConvertBtn, "Convert", "Auto Convert Cash", function()
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local Event = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("LaunderingRemotes"):WaitForChild("RequestLaunder")
        Event:FireServer("WashingMachine")
    end)
    if not success then
        warn("Convert error:", err)
    end
end)

-- 2. Auto Claim Cash Logic
setupToggle(ClaimBtn, "Claim", "Auto Claim Cash", function()
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local Event = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PrinterRemotes"):WaitForChild("RequestAction")
        Event:FireServer("RustyPrinter", "Claim")
    end)
    if not success then
        warn("Claim error:", err)
    end
end)

-- 3. Auto Upgrade Cash Logic
setupToggle(UpgradeBtn, "Upgrade", "Auto Upgrade Cash", function()
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local Event = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PrinterRemotes"):WaitForChild("RequestAction")
        Event:FireServer("RustyPrinter", "Upgrade")
    end)
    if not success then
        warn("Upgrade error:", err)
    end
end)

scripts.script:
--// PANEL DE PRUEBAS - ROBLOX STUDIO
--// Coloca este LocalScript en:
--// StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- CONFIGURACIÓN
local NORMAL_SPEED = 30
local FAST_SPEED = 100

local noclip = false
local speedEnabled = false

--// GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "TestPanel"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Botón para volver a abrir
local openButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
openButton.Name = "OpenButton"
openButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 40)
openButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, -60)
openButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
openButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
openButton.Text = "ABRIR GUI"
openButton.TextSize = 16
openButton.Visible = false
openButton.Parent = gui

local cornerOpen = Instance.new("UICorner")
cornerOpen.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
cornerOpen.Parent = openButton

-- Panel principal
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name = "Main"
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 260)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 0.5, -130)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
frame.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
corner.Parent = frame

-- Título
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -45, 0, 45)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "⚙ PANEL DE PRUEBAS"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.TextSize = 18
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = frame

-- Botón X
local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 35)
close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 5)
close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
close.Text = "X"
close.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
close.TextSize = 18
close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
close.Parent = frame

local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
closeCorner.Parent = close

-- Función para crear botones
local function createButton(text, y)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 45)
	button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, y)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
	button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	button.Text = text
	button.TextSize = 16
	button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	button.Parent = frame

	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	c.Parent = button

	return button
end

local speedButton = createButton("⚡ Velocidad: OFF", 55)
local noclipButton = createButton("👻 Noclip: OFF", 110)
local balanceButton = createButton("💰 Saldo infinito", 165)

--// VELOCIDAD
speedButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	speedEnabled = not speedEnabled

	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if humanoid then
		if speedEnabled then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = FAST_SPEED
			speedButton.Text = "⚡ Velocidad: ON"
			speedButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 70)
		else
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = NORMAL_SPEED
			speedButton.Text = "⚡ Velocidad: OFF"
			speedButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
		end
	end
end)

--// NOCLIP
RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	if not noclip then
		return
	end

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end

	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
end)

noclipButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	noclip = not noclip

	if noclip then
		noclipButton.Text = "👻 Noclip: ON"
		noclipButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 70)
	else
		noclipButton.Text = "👻 Noclip: OFF"
		noclipButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)

		local character = player.Character
		if character then
			for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					part.CanCollide = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

--// SALDO INFINITO
-- Esto busca un leaderstats llamado "Saldo" o "Balance".
-- Para un sistema real, el cambio debe hacerse en un Script del servidor.

balanceButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")

	if not leaderstats then
		balanceButton.Text = "❌ No existe leaderstats"
		task.wait(2)
		balanceButton.Text = "💰 Saldo infinito"
		return
	end

	local saldo = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Saldo")
		or leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Balance")
		or leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Money")
		or leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")

	if saldo and (saldo:IsA("IntValue") or saldo:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		saldo.Value = math.huge
		balanceButton.Text = "💰 Saldo: INFINITO"
		balanceButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 70)
	else
		balanceButton.Text = "❌ No encontré el saldo"
		task.wait(2)
		balanceButton.Text = "💰 Saldo infinito"
	end
end)

--// CERRAR GUI
close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	frame.Visible = false
	openButton.Visible = true
end)

--// ABRIR GUI
openButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	frame.Visible = true
	openButton.Visible = false
end)

--// HACER EL GUI ARRASTRABLE
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = frame.Position
	end
end)

title.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = false
	end
end)

title.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local connection
		connection = input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
				connection:Disconnect()
			end
		end)
	end
end)

game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then
		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		frame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPosition.X.Scale,
			startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPosition.Y.Scale,
			startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

--// REAPLICAR VELOCIDAD DESPUÉS DE MORIR
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	if speedEnabled then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = FAST_SPEED
	else
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = NORMAL_SPEED
	end
end)

TextLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
TextLabel.Text = nameText
TextLabel.Parent = RowFrame
-- Toggle Switch Outer Body
local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 24)
ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0.5, -12)
ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_OFF
ToggleBtn.Text = ""
ToggleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
ToggleBtn.Parent = RowFrame
local ToggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ToggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
ToggleCorner.Parent = ToggleBtn
-- Toggle Switch Sliding Indicator (Slider Knob)
local Slider = Instance.new("Frame")
Slider.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
Slider.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -9)
Slider.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Slider.BorderSizePixel = 0
Slider.Parent = ToggleBtn
local SliderCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SliderCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
SliderCorner.Parent = Slider
return ToggleBtn, Slider
end
-- Helper function to style standard instantaneous action buttons
local function styleActionButton(btn, text, order)
btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 38)
btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
btn.TextSize = 13
btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
btn.Text = text
btn.LayoutOrder = order
btn.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_ACTION
btn.AutoButtonColor = false
local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
btnCorner.Parent = btn
local btnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
btnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
btnStroke.Transparency = 0.85
btnStroke.Thickness = 1
btnStroke.Parent = btn
btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
if MainFrame.Size == UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 315) then
TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 234, 0, 40)}):Play()
TweenService:Create(btnStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Transparency = 0.5}):Play()
end
end)
btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
if MainFrame.Size == UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 315) then
TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 38)}):Play()
TweenService:Create(btnStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Transparency = 0.85}):Play()
end
end)
btn.Parent = Container
end
-- Instantiating Components
local SpinBotBtn, SpinSlider = createToggleRow("spinBOT", 1)
local TpAwayBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
styleActionButton(TpAwayBtn, "tpAWAY", 2)
local TpBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
styleActionButton(TpBtn, "tp", 3)
local AngryTpBtn, AngrySlider = createToggleRow("angryTP", 4)
local TpUpBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
styleActionButton(TpUpBtn, "tpUP", 5)
-- State tracking variables
local spinbotOn = false
local angryTpOn = false
local spinConnection
local angryTpConnection
local isMinimized = false
-- Helper functional loop for toggle animation triggers
local function animateToggle(btn, slider, state)
local targetPos = state and UDim2.new(1, -21, 0.5, -9) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -9)
local targetColor = state and COLOR_ON or COLOR_OFF
TweenService:Create(slider, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = targetPos}):Play()
TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundColor3 = targetColor}):Play()
end
-- Character Position Logic Extensions
local function getBehindCFrame(targetPlayer)
if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character and targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
local targetRoot = targetPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
return targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
end
return nil
end
local function getRandomPlayer()
local allPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
local available = {}
for _, p in ipairs(allPlayers) do
if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
table.insert(available, p)
end
end
if #available > 0 then
return available[math.random(1, #available)]
end
return nil
end
-- MECHANICS: SpinBOT Action Hook
SpinBotBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
spinbotOn = not spinbotOn
animateToggle(SpinBotBtn, SpinSlider, spinbotOn)
if spinbotOn then
spinConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
local char = LocalPlayer.Character
local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if root then
root.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(140), 0)
end
end)
else
if spinConnection then
spinConnection:Disconnect()
spinConnection = nil
end
end
end)
-- MECHANICS: tpAWAY Action Hook
TpAwayBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
local char = LocalPlayer.Character
local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if root then
root.CFrame = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(3000000, 0, 0)
end
end)
-- MECHANICS: tp Action Hook
TpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
local char = LocalPlayer.Character
local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if root then
local target = getRandomPlayer()
if target then
local targetCFrame = getBehindCFrame(target)
if targetCFrame then
root.CFrame = targetCFrame
end
end
end
end)
-- MECHANICS: angryTP Action Hook
AngryTpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
angryTpOn = not angryTpOn
animateToggle(AngryTpBtn, AngrySlider, angryTpOn)
if angryTpOn then
angryTpConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
local char = LocalPlayer.Character
local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if root then
local target = getRandomPlayer()
if target then
local targetCFrame = getBehindCFrame(target)
if targetCFrame then
root.CFrame = targetCFrame
end
end
end
end)
else
if angryTpConnection then
angryTpConnection:Disconnect()
angryTpConnection = nil
end
end
end)
-- MECHANICS: tpUP Action Hook
TpUpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
local char = LocalPlayer.Character
local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if root then
root.CFrame = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 20000, 0)
end
end)
-- MECHANICS: Minimize Button ("-") To Turn Whole GUI Into A Circle
MinimizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
isMinimized = not isMinimized
if isMinimized then
-- Hide content container, shrink to small circle size, round corners to perfect circle
Container.Visible = false
TitleLabel.Visible = false
MinimizeBtn.Text = "+"
TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 45)
}):Play()
TweenService:Create(UICorner, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 22)
}):Play()
TweenService:Create(TopCorner, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 22)
}):Play()
TweenService:Create(TopBanner, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
}):Play()
TweenService:Create(ControlsContainer, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
}):Play()
ControlsLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
else
-- Restore original layout parameters
MinimizeBtn.Text = "-"
ControlsLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
local mainTween = TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 315)
})
TweenService:Create(UICorner, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
}):Play()
TweenService:Create(TopCorner, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
}):Play()
TweenService:Create(TopBanner, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
}):Play()
TweenService:Create(ControlsContainer, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 1, 0),
Position = UDim2.new(1, -65, 0, 0)
}):Play()
mainTween.Completed:Connect(function()
if not isMinimized then
Container.Visible = true
TitleLabel.Visible = true
end
end)
mainTween:Play()
end
end)
-- MECHANICS: Close Button ("X") To Close Entire GUI
CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
-- Disconnect loops safely before removal
if spinConnection then spinConnection:Disconnect() end
if angryTpConnection then angryTpConnection:Disconnect() end
ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)
-- Dragging logic framework handles panel updates seamlessly
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
local function update(input)
local delta = input.Position - dragStart
TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
}):Play()
end
MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = true
dragStart = input.Position
startPos = MainFrame.Position
input.Changed:Connect(function()
if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
dragging = false
end
end)
end
end)
MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragInput = input
end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if input == dragInput and dragging then
update(input)
end
end)

Full bright 
No fog

Note: This is NOT an optimization script
scripts.script:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
Lighting.FogStart = 0
Lighting.ClockTime = 14
Lighting.Brightness = 2
Lighting.GlobalShadows = false

local function removeSkybox()
	for _, object in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
		if object:IsA("Sky") then
			object:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

removeSkybox()

Lighting.ChildAdded:Connect(function(object)
	if object:IsA("Sky") then
		object:Destroy()
	end
end)


if not _G.FullBrightExecuted then
	_G.FullBrightEnabled = false

	_G.NormalLightingSettings = {
		Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
		ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
		FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
		GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
		Ambient = Lighting.Ambient
	}

	_G.FullBrightExecuted = true
end

local function applyLighting()
	if _G.FullBrightEnabled then
		Lighting.Brightness = 1
		Lighting.ClockTime = 12
		Lighting.FogEnd = 786543
		Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
		Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 178)
	else
		Lighting.Brightness = _G.NormalLightingSettings.Brightness
		Lighting.ClockTime = _G.NormalLightingSettings.ClockTime
		Lighting.FogEnd = _G.NormalLightingSettings.FogEnd
		Lighting.GlobalShadows = _G.NormalLightingSettings.GlobalShadows
		Lighting.Ambient = _G.NormalLightingSettings.Ambient
	end
end

_G.FullBrightEnabled = not _G.FullBrightEnabled
applyLighting()
removeSkybox()
